line: push    ebx; Count all 21 native player skills into five SkillMasteryLevel buckets for the Stats menu. Major/non-major membership is not consulted.

call    ActorValue_GetAVFromGroupOffset; mwMediumArmor: Oblivion group 2 maps skill offset to actor value by adding 0x0C. OpenMW/Morrowind skill index 2 is MediumArmor, but Oblivion offset 2 becomes actor value 0x0E (Blade). Do not pass Morrowind skill indexes directly through this helper.

call    Actor_GetSkillMasteryLevel; Oblivion skill-mastery accessor. Accept only native skill AVs 0x0C..0x20, compute the actor's base calculated skill, and map it through the five configurable mastery thresholds.

jl      short StatsMenu_MiscTab_HandleClick___CalcSkillMasteryCounts; Complete the fixed 21-skill mastery-count loop; the resulting five counts are purely value/rank based, independent of TESClass majors.
mov     [esp+arg_10], 5; Finish counting the fixed 21 native skills into the five mastery buckets used by the Stats menu.
